meta.title: Two waves (fictional scenario)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-wave-scenarios.ts (two-waves) with seed 20261113. The same survey run twice, six months apart. In wave 1, Support works mostly within itself and reaches the rest through SUP01 and through BRI01, a coordinator in Build who is the main route between Support and Sales. Between the waves BRI01 and SAL07 left (off the wave 2 roster, their wave 1 ratings kept) and SUP09, SUP10 and SAL08 joined (on the wave 2 roster only). In wave 2 a joint programme ties Build and Support more closely. DES06 gave no ratings in wave 1; in wave 2 SUP09 gave none and BUI05 answered about half the survey. The rosters of both waves are recorded.
